body:
The invalid-user-ID verification test used 123, which can equal the factory user ID after PostgreSQL sequences advance. Using the generated ID plus one guarantees that the signed link targets a different user. Both original assertions remain: no Verified event and the account stays unverified.

Normal refresh onto main141418b067766512bfa57d1ff36391bb60aeff04 preserves the exact original test blob and one-line diff. Independent source review cleared c359d0cb56e22dc7c30fb874d3cccc7c7d495a5e. On this refreshed candidate all six email-verification tests /16 assertions pass with a clean exit; Pint and diff checks pass. Prior controlled ID123 diagnostics (eight total tests /28 assertions) remain recorded separately; they were not rerun or added to this one-file patch.

No application, assertion, permission, migration or production change. Fresh exact-head CI and then-current-main containment remain required before merge.
